evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 5.2 ppm before rising to 11.8 ppm at 2880 s and 19.0 ppm at 3000 s.
Pressure rose from 3.055 Torr at 2760 s to 3.110 Torr at 2880 s and 3.196 Torr at 3000 s despite unchanged growth setpoints.
Argon flow remains near its 100 sccm setpoint at 99.8 sccm.
Temperature remains near its 750 C setpoint at 750.4 C.

args.missing_evidence: A leak-integrity check and exhaust conductance/backpressure measurements are needed to distinguish air ingress from an exhaust restriction or other atmospheric disturbance; no sample characterization is available.
